facts.text: I have been traveling a lot lately.
I want to keep track of my trips by making a list of all the places I've been to recently.
I want to focus on the last 3 months.
I want to list domestic trips within the US.
I want to organize my list by city.
I want my list to include dates and modes of transportation if possible.
I spent 5 days at my aunt's house in Miami.
I went to Chicago on February 10th for a business meeting.
I flew with United Airlines to Chicago.
I went to New York City on February 17th for a friend's birthday party.
I stayed in New York City for 3 nights.
I took the subway to get around New York City.
I took a quick 3-day trip to Los Angeles for a conference on March 1st.
I flew with American Airlines to Los Angeles.
I flew to Miami on April 12th.
My Miami trip dates should be April 12th - 17th.
